Emaar gates the brochure, floor plans and payment plan behind a 'Register Your Interest' form asking for name, email and phone - that form was NOT filled in and nothing behind it was fetched, so NO floor plans are registered for any Emaar project. Emaar's own alt text is worthless ('Strapi image', 'Property Image 1') and its filenames are generic ('feature_block_0'), so EVERY image below was downloaded and looked at; the notes describe what was actually on screen, not the filename. Images the page also carries but which are excluded here: the shared 'attraction' set (Burj Khalifa, The Dubai Mall, Dubai Fountain, Dubai Opera, Ras Al Khor, Creek Marina etc) - these are generic neighbourhood landmark photos reused verbatim across every Emaar project in the same community and are not this building; and any 'brochure_Image' thumbnail, which is 300x210 and under the size floor. Best-documented Emaar project found: it is one of only two in this batch where Emaar populates the 'exteriorGallery' and 'interiorGallery' CMS fields. All three files named 'exterior_*' were checked and all three genuinely ARE exteriors, and all three 'interior_*' genuinely ARE interiors - on this project the filenames are honest. 'hero_slide_1' is the same render as the hero image (not byte-identical, different file), so only the hero is registered from that pair.
